name: Dhampir
summary: Mortals touched by vampirism who climb like spiders and feed on the vitality of those they bite.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in Dim Light within 60 feet as if it were Bright Light, and in Darkness as if it were Dim Light.
traits.text: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.summary: A Climb Speed equal to your Speed; from level 3 you can move along walls and ceilings with your hands free.
traits.text: You have a Climb Speed equal to your Speed. Starting at character level 3, you can move up, down and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings while leaving your hands free.

traits.name: Trace of Undeath
traits.text: You have Resistance to Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Vampiric Bite
traits.summary: Unarmed Strike bite: 1d4 + Constitution modifier Piercing. On a hit, PB times per Long Rest, heal the damage dealt or add it to your next attack roll or ability check.
traits.text: When you make an Unarmed Strike, you can bite with your fangs instead of using the normal damage: on a hit the bite deals 1d4 plus your Constitution modifier Piercing damage. When you bite a creature that isn't a Construct or an Undead, you can empower yourself in one of these ways: Drain: you regain Hit Points equal to the Piercing damage dealt. Strengthen: you gain a bonus equal to the Piercing damage dealt to the next ability check or attack roll you make within 1 minute. You can empower yourself a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all uses on a Long Rest.
